title: Kitchen break
intro: A few small things to do while you are up and about.

prompts.text: Fill a glass with water and drink it slowly.
Put the kettle on and watch it, just for the pleasure of waiting.
Rinse a cup or two while you are there.
Choose a snack you will enjoy rather than eat in a hurry.
Stand by the sink and stretch your arms overhead.
Open the window or door for a moment of fresh air.
Wipe one worktop clean and see how it looks.
Hold a warm mug in both hands and just notice the warmth.
Walk a slow loop around the kitchen before you head back.
Refill a water bottle for your desk.
Look at what is outside the kitchen window for a minute.

backAtDesk: Welcome back. Your drink will keep you company.
